note: Moldova: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days in any 180; citizens of other countries may apply for an e-Visa (up to 20 days' processing), those of most African Union states and others with an invitation from the General Inspectorate for Migration first (not modelled apart). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
